mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (requester_id, receiver_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{receiverId}, #{status}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

mapper.update: UPDATE friend SET status = #{status}, accepted_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ACCEPTED' THEN NOW() ELSE accepted_at END WHERE friend_id = #{friendId} AND status = 'PENDING'

mapper.update: UPDATE friend SET status = 'TERMINATED', terminated_at = NOW() WHERE friend_id = #{friendId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
